containerEncryption: AES-256-GCM; outer file suffix .zip.enc; password is configured only through BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD
archiveFormat: mongodump --out=<directory> --gzip; each collection is BSON gzip plus metadata.json
restore: If Telegram split the backup into parts, concatenate them in order to reconstruct the full .zip.enc file; decrypt it using BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD, unzip the resulting ZIP, then run: mongorestore --uri="<MONGO_URI>" --gzip --drop ./dump
